headline: China Railway Resources commits $600M to Zimbabwe gold projects
summary: China Railway Resources Group has signed an agreement to invest over $600 million into four large-scale gold projects in Zimbabwe. The investment aims to revive brownfield assets including the Vubachikwe and Gaika mines.
why: Foreign direct investment in mining is a significant driver of economic activity and export revenue for Zimbabwe.
